entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55615
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55607

  • [dotnet-sdk-11.0.100-rc.1.26404.101] Execute command "dotnet tool install" get error: Unhandled exception: The type initializer for 'Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.TransactionalAction' threw an exception. #55604
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With .NET 11.0.100-rc.1.26404.101, dnx/dotnet tool exec failed with "Unhandled exception: The type initializer for 'Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.TransactionalAction' threw an exception." #55603
